page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head and page number at the top right. No margin notes. The left edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page, which are not transcribed. At the foot: catchword at the right and gathering signature at the left.

main_text.p: tum fuit, quod novam illam liturgiam, antiquata veteri, ecclesiis inconsultis & repugnantibus praele- gerit, Cumque classis judicium subterfugiens, ad Synodum nationalem provocaverit, eam itidem a- spernatus fit, Episcoporum protestatione[?] contra Sy- nodum subscribens: ob quod contumaciæ crimen, licet alia abessent, Depositionisà ministerii functione & excommunicationis censura notandus esset; secun- dum expressam constitutionem Synodi nationalis Andreapolitanæ anni 1582. Ex eodem luto factum fuisse D. Pantherum seu Panitarium. S S. Theologiæ professorem in Academia Andreapolitana comper- tum fuit; Gladstono autem Archidiacono Andrea- politano, ejusque ecclesiæ pastori præter Contuma- ciam adversus Synodum, objectum fuit ordinariæ ebrietatis scandalum & vitæ profanitas: Quos tres supradictorum criminum reos & convictos teneri liquido probatum fuit:
main_text.head: Sess. 11. Decemb. 3. Die Lunæ.
main_text.p: Post doctam & accuratam heterodoxiarum Ar- minianarum refutationem, institutam per Davidem Dicksonum Irwinensis ecclesiæ pastorem, sententia depositionis à functione pastorali in Davidem Mit- chelium concordibus omnium suffragiis lata est: exhibitæ fuerunt literæ Episcopi Orcadum ad syno- dum; quibus absentiam suam in ætatem provectam, morbum, itineris difficultates hyberno hoc tempo- re conjiciebat, pollicitus synodi judicio se submis- surum: Designati fuerunt quidam quibus tanquam Synodi deputatis commissum fuit causas pastorum Edenburgensium & aliorum in vicino illo tractu cognoscere post synodum dimissam.
main_text.head: Sess. 12. Decemb. 4. Die Martis.
main_text.p: Post nervosam & solidam dogmatum Arminia- norum refutationem, per Robertum Bailium Kilwi- ninæ ecclesiæ pastorem; accusantur pastores qui- dam

page.notes: No margin notes or foot notes on this page. The left edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. Doubtful readings: "protestatione[?]" (the word is unclear in the scan). Headings "Sess." and the dated lines were set as level 3 because they are small dated titles set apart. Long s is written as plain s throughout, as instructed.
